# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Visual system (applies throughout)**
- **Palette:** Deep ink teal (#0F3B3F) for text and dark bands, warm sand (#F6F1E7) for backgrounds, coral (#E8715A) for primary buttons only, sage (#A8C5B5) for secondary tints.
- **Type:** Fraunces (serif) for headlines, Inter for body and UI labels. Headlines at 56px desktop / 36px mobile.
- **Imagery:** Product screenshots in rounded frames with soft shadows. Thin wave-line illustrations as dividers. No stock photos of people at laptops.

**1. Navigation**
Layout: Logo left, three links center (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Start free" button right. Sticky, sand background, collapses to a menu icon under 768px.
Copy: Nav labels only, plain nouns.

**2. Hero**
Layout: Two columns. Headline and CTA left; product screenshot of the weekly board right, slightly tilted and overlapping the sand background edge.
Visual: Sand background with a faint teal wave pattern at the bottom.
Copy: Headline "Your team's week, planned together." Subhead: "Tidepool turns scattered priorities into one shared week in about ten minutes." Primary button "Plan this week" (coral). Secondary text link "See how it works." Small line below: "Free for teams of five."

**3. Problem strip**
Layout: Full-width teal band, three short statements in a row.
Visual: White text, sage icons.
Copy: Name the pain directly: "Priorities live in six threads." "Nobody knows who owns Thursday." "Monday standup repeats Friday's chaos."

**4. How it works**
Layout: Three numbered columns with a connecting wave line.
Visual: Small illustrated tiles, one per step, in sage and sand.
Copy: "Capture" (drop in tasks from anywhere), "Assign" (one owner per item, drag to a day), "Sync" (one shared view every morning). Each under 20 words.

**5. Feature spotlight**
Layout: Alternating image-left, text-right. Large screenshot of the team board with real-looking task names.
Visual: Sand background, teal annotation callouts on the screenshot.
Copy: Headline "See the whole week in one glance." Three bullets on capacity warnings, owner avatars, and carry-over of unfinished work.

**6. Social proof**
Layout: Single large pull quote centered, then a row of three small team logos.
Visual: Coral quotation mark, serif quote text.
Copy: A specific, numeric quote: "We cut our Monday meeting from 45 minutes to 10."

**7. Pricing**
Layout: Two cards side by side: Free (up to five people) and Team ($8 per person/month). Team card highlighted with a teal border.
Visual: Sand cards on sand background, coral "Most teams" tag.
Copy: Short feature lists, no more than five bullets each.

**8. FAQ**
Layout: Single column accordion, six questions.
Copy: Address objections: "Does it replace our calendar?" "Can we import from Notion or Asana?"

**9. Final CTA**
Layout: Full-width teal band, centered headline and one button.
Copy: "Plan next week before Monday." Button "Start free."

**10. Footer**
Layout: Four columns of links, wave illustration at top edge.
Copy: Product, Company, Resources, Legal. Small line: "Tidepool, calm weeks for small teams."

# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**Changes from v1:** Sharper headline promise, real product in the hero, specific pain copy, a named-customer proof point, accessibility fixes for button and text contrast, a mobile CTA bar, and a measurable trial offer.

**Visual system**
- **Palette:** Ink teal (#0F3B3F) for text and dark bands. Warm sand (#F6F1E7) for backgrounds. Coral (#F08A73) for primary buttons, with ink text on it (4.8:1 contrast). Sage (#A8C5B5) is decorative only, never text.
- **Type:** Fraunces for headlines (56px desktop, 36px mobile). Inter for body (18px desktop, 16px mobile minimum) and UI labels.
- **Imagery:** Real product screenshots with realistic task names and a visible capacity bar. Rounded frames, soft shadows. Thin wave lines as section dividers. No stock photos.

**1. Navigation**
Logo left. Links center: Product, Pricing, Stories. Right: "Log in" text link and coral "Start free" button. Sticky on sand. Under 768px, collapses to a menu icon.

**2. Hero**
Two columns. Left: headline, subhead, buttons, trust line. Right: tilted screenshot of the weekly board showing Thursday's capacity bar in coral.
- Headline: "Plan your team's week before Monday starts."
- Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams one shared week. Every task gets one owner, and every day shows its load."
- Primary button: "Start free." Secondary link: "Watch the 2-minute tour."
- Trust line: "Free for teams up to five. No card required."

**3. Problem strip**
Full-width teal band, three statements, sage icons. Name specific pain:
- "Your plan lives in six threads and two DMs."
- "Thursday has three owners and zero owners."
- "Monday standup rebuilds a week you already planned."

**4. How it works**
Three columns with a connecting wave line. Each step gets a cropped screenshot of that step's actual interface, not an illustration.
- **Capture:** Forward tasks from email or Slack. (Under 20 words.)
- **Assign:** One owner per item. Drag to a day.
- **Review:** Check each person's load every morning.
- Small caption: "Most teams finish setup in under ten minutes."

**5. Feature spotlight**
Alternating layout, sand background. Large board screenshot with teal callouts.
- Headline: "Spot an overloaded Thursday before it happens."
- Bullets: capacity warnings in hours per person; unfinished work rolls forward with a visible note; owner avatars on every item.

**6. Social proof**
Centered pull quote in serif with a coral quotation mark. Attribution includes name, role, and company. Below: a row of three stats.
- Quote: "We cut our Monday meeting from 45 minutes to 10."
- Placeholder: replace with a verified customer quote before launch. Show logos only with permission.

**7. Pricing**
Two cards on sand. Free: up to five people. Team: $8 per person per month, or $6 billed annually. Team card has an ink-teal border and a coral "Most popular" tag. Five bullets max per card. Beneath: "Cancel anytime. Export everything."

**8. FAQ**
Single-column accordion, six questions. Address real objections:
- Does it replace our calendar?
- Can we import from Notion or Asana?
- Who can see our tasks?
- What happens to our data if we cancel?

**9. Final CTA**
Full-width ink-teal band. Headline: "Plan next week before Monday." Subline: "Free for five. Set up in ten minutes." Button: "Start free."

**10. Footer**
Wave divider at top. Four link columns: Product, Company, Resources, Legal. Include Privacy, Security, and Status. Tagline: "Tidepool: calm weeks for small teams."

**Mobile and measurement**
- Stack hero screenshot below copy. Keep the coral CTA sticky at the bottom after the hero.
- Track clicks on each primary button, pricing-card selections, and scroll depth to the pricing section to judge whether the page converts.
